title: Sunday · overrun
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The opposite: the beach in August packed edge to edge, umbrellas, the drift log invisible under people, the pup on a leash for the first time in a Sunday. The strip counts nobody.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the beach from the bluff stairs, packed: umbrellas, coolers, kites, hundreds of figures, the drift log somewhere under them. A man and a leashed three-legged dog at the bottom of the stairs, from behind, stopped.

characters.pose: from behind, at the bottom of the stairs

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, a beach seen from bluff stairs packed edge to edge with umbrellas, coolers, kites and hundreds of people, a man and a small three-legged dog on a leash stopped at the foot of the stairs seen from behind, no words
image.notes: The only Sunday where the pup is on a leash.

panels.name: Packed

panels.composition: Tier 2: the drift log, with four strangers sitting on it and a towel over its end.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, a bleached drift log on a crowded beach with four strangers sitting on it and a towel draped over one end, no words

panels.name: Log

panels.composition: Tier 3: the man and the dog going back up the stairs. The beach below, full. Held.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, a man and a small three-legged dog climbing back up bluff stairs away from a packed beach below, seen from behind, no words

panels.name: Up

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: Overrun. The log occupied. They go back up.
